comparison.objective: Candidate commissions and locks a shock absorber by tuning dynamic stopping response; pr-125 aligns pipe flanges and inserts locating pins.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires hex-key engagement, setscrew release/locking, fine collar rotation, counterholding, and iterative impact-response tuning. pr-125 requires flange transport/alignment and repeated pin insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe physical cycles within stroke/energy/velocity limits, no hard-stop strike or setting drift, and verified locking. pr-125 scores final flange poses and pin seating. Candidate omits numeric rebound, overload, locking-torque, and collar-drift thresholds.
comparison.reason: The tested mechanism, manipulation sequence, feedback loop, and endpoint are meaningfully different; shared alignment and bimanual stabilization are only generic primitives.
